name: Human Powered Health
verdict: Human Powered Health is a US healthcare company whose name the team carries; it is a subsidiary of Optum, one of UnitedHealth Group's two businesses. Nothing found.
note: US health and athletic performance company (performance labs plus the HumanGO training app). Chain: Human Powered Health -> Optum -> UnitedHealth Group (US listed company). No state capital in the chain and no human-rights finding against the company itself found; see the pull request.
